news.title: Study gauges efficiency of Affordable Care Act at reducing uninsured rates
news.summary_en: UChicago economist finds public coverage helped poorest households while often replacing employer-sponsored insurance at higher incomes

news.title: UChicago psychology study points to new potential for treating eating disorders
news.summary_en: With fMRI scans and computational modeling, researchers find food decisions in anorexia engage brain region tied to inflexible habits

news.title: Space travel doesn’t affect the strength of heart muscle cells, study finds
news.summary_en: UChicago-led research on cells from mice that had been on the International Space Station for more than a month suggests astronaut hearts can withstand longer trips
